item.title: City hall ceremony honors first graduates of Atmore Police Department Youth Explorer Program
item.description: Atmore Police honored the first graduates of its free, two‑month Youth Explorer Program, whose weekly after‑school training leads to volunteer roles with the department.

item.title: Atmore chamber partners with Grace Fellowship Atmore to support Upward Sports program
item.description: Atmore Chamber teams with Grace Fellowship Atmore to support the Upward Sports program, helping fund flag football and cheerleading for local elementary students.

item.title: Julia LaFaye Hubert
item.description: Julia LaFaye Hubert, of Atmore, passed away on Fri., January 30, 2026 at Sacred Heart Hospital in Pensacola, Fla. A viewing will be held this Fri., February 6, 2026 from 5 p.m. until 8 p.m. in the funeral home chapel. A funeral service will be held this Sat., February 7, 2026 at 11 a.m. at Faith Tabernacle with Christian Memorial Funeral Home directing.

item.title: Amelia B. Rolin
item.description: Amelia Belle Rolin was a precious infant who was born on January 20, 2026, in Fairhope, and passed away just 10 days later on January 30, 2026, in Mobile. She was preceded in death by great-grandparents, Jimmy Dukes, Clarence Leon "Lee" Rolin; step-grandfather, Glenn Knowles; great-great grandparents, Marlon Nelson Sr., Mary Nelson, Roberta McGhee Sells and Eugene Sells, Woodrow (Estelle McGhee) Rolin, Milton "Half" (Lucille Jackson) Sells, Leo (Laverne) Luker Sr. and Dr. James (Virginia) Dukes

item.title: EA beats Wilcox Academy 64-47 on senior night Monday
item.description: Escambia Academy’s boys basketball team defeated Wilcox Academy 64-47 on senior night Monday in Canoe. With the victory, the Cougars improve to 14-4 overall, and 6-1 in AISA Class 1A, Region 2, Area 2 play. EA locked up the No. 1 seed going into the Elite Eight, and will receive a bye in the first round. Before the postseason starts for EA, the Cougars have one last home game tonight against South Choctaw.

item.description: Tickets are now on sale for GECA's Twinderella, featuring actors ages 6–18, with performances February 19–22. Purchase tickets at gecarts.org.

item.title: Six Escambia County High School athletes sign to play at next level on 2026 National Signing Day
item.description: Six Escambia County High athletes sign to continue their careers at colleges and prep programs, celebrating hard work and new opportunities on 2026 National Signing Day.

item.title: Holiday Hustle Challenge: 44 teams lose 520 pounds, gain 75 pounds of muscle
item.description: In Poarch’s nine-week Holiday Hustle Challenge, 44 teams lost 520 pounds and gained 75 pounds of lean muscle, led by first-place finishers The Flab Four and New Year, New Me.

item.title: Beth Wiggins prepares for March Mount Kilimanjaro climb with G 2/3 Island Warriors
item.description: Double-amputee Marine veteran Beth Wiggins is training and fundraising to join an all-female G 2/3 Island Warriors climb of Mount Kilimanjaro in March.
